title: Pressure injury stages

findings.where: pressure-injury.jsx — stageFrom(), PRESSURE_CONTEXT, OTHER_STAGING and mentions()
findings.title: Stage selection is not reliably bound to the pressure injury
findings.problem: stageFrom("A client with CKD stage 4 has a sacral pressure injury.") returns stage 4 even though only CKD was staged. OTHER_STAGING checks disease names after the stage, not before it. Likewise, "Which finding would indicate a stage 4 pressure injury?" returns stage 4 despite being hypothetical. These branches can place an authoritative stage highlight beside a question that has not established that pressure-injury stage.
findings.fix: Require an asserted current stage explicitly associated with the pressure injury, preferably supplied as validated structured question data. Otherwise return null. Add regression tests for disease-before-stage wording, hypothetical questions, and negation scoped to unrelated findings.

findings.where: Images 1, 7, 9 and 15; step 'other'; DTPI constant, caption and narration
findings.title: The taught DTPI definition drops the dark open-wound presentation
findings.problem: Fact 7 correctly includes epidermal separation revealing a dark wound bed. The visible definition and narration reduce DTPI to discoloration or a blood-filled blister. That removes a defining non-intact presentation needed to distinguish DTPI from a Stage 2 wound with a viable pink/red dermal bed.
findings.fix: Include epidermal separation revealing a dark wound bed in the visible and spoken explanation. State that DTPI may have intact or non-intact skin and retain the pressure/shear context.

findings.title: Critical lesion features lose contrast in dark mode
findings.problem: Fixed black overlays darken the coral eschar and DTPI markings against already-dark tissue. The DTPI surface patch becomes approximately #7B3E34, only about 1.7–1.9:1 against its surrounding dark backgrounds; the eschar boundary is weaker still. These are essential instructional features, not decorative shading.
findings.fix: Use theme-aware shading and add a contrasting boundary around the eschar and DTPI lesions. Preserve their dark appearance without making their outlines disappear, and verify the resulting contrast against each adjacent tissue band.

findings.where: Images 3–6 and 11–14; individual stage steps; regions.layers and viewFor()
findings.title: Stage-step cropping retains the entire definition stack
findings.problem: Every individual stage step focuses 'layers', whose region extends through noteY below all four stage definitions. Consequently, all four paragraphs remain between the cross-section and the active caption, adding several hundred CSS pixels on a phone. Only the column shapes are isolated; the explanation is not.
findings.fix: Restrict the shared layers region to the cross-sections and legend. Move the progression/healing note into a separate region, and show only the selected stage definition during individual stage steps. Keep the complete stack in the inline overview.

assessment: Hold publication. The stage extractor can highlight a stage never assigned to the pressure injury. The DTPI explanation omits a defining presentation, and dark-theme lesion contrast needs correction.
